Name: UCL1-VOM-England-16-22
Title: England VOM Canopy Height (2016–2022)
Description: England Vegetation Object Model (VOM) Canopy Height raster (2022), derived from Defra/Environment Agency LiDAR. Values represent tree height in metres (file range ~2–30 m; rendered with the same colour LUT as the 10 m Meta-WRI Canopy Height Model for visual comparability). Coverage: England only.
